rh.test_set_integrity.test_set_for_evalu.reason: Held-out Helm judgments influence fitting through response-dependent preprocessing. Each training response is divided by its observer-series mean over all pairs, including held-out pairs. This is not stimulus-only normalization; the subsequent model has a shared Helm link and cannot generally absorb observer-specific changes with one scale.
evidence: proposal/code/datasets.py:199–202 computes d_norm=dissimilarity/series_mean before constructing the dataset.
